scenarios.title: Short-circuit favicon requests without processing
given: A scan route request where the code segment contains the substring "favicon" (e.g. `/12345/favicon.ico`)
scenarios.when: The client requests the scan endpoint
then: The request is rejected as not found

scenarios.title: Redirect to setup when no vendor code is supplied or present in session
given: A client without an active exhibitor session
scenarios.when: The client requests a scan for a numeric badge identifier without a code segment (e.g. `GET /12345`)
then: The client is redirected to the setup page with the badge identifier parameter (e.g. `/setup?id=12345`)

scenarios.title: Record scan with an explicit vendor code segment and save code to session
given: A numeric badge identifier (e.g. `12345`) and an explicit vendor code segment (e.g. `EXHIBIT100`)
The scan query returns exactly one matching record
scenarios.when: The client scans the badge with the explicit vendor code segment (e.g. `GET /12345/EXHIBIT100`)
then: The client receives the scan confirmation page displaying the vendor code
A subsequent scan request without an explicit code succeeds using the saved vendor code

scenarios.title: Record scan reusing vendor code established from setup submission
given: A client establishes an exhibitor code session by submitting the setup form (e.g. `POST /setup` with code `BOOTH77`)
The scan query returns exactly one matching record
scenarios.when: The client scans a numeric badge identifier with no code segment (e.g. `GET /12345`) using the established session
then: The client receives the scan confirmation page displaying the vendor code configured during setup

scenarios.title: Display error message when scan query does not return exactly one record
given: A numeric badge identifier and a vendor code (e.g. `UNKNOWN99`)
The scan query returns zero matching records
scenarios.when: The client submits a scan request
then: The client receives an error page
The error message "That code didn't look right." is displayed

scenarios.title: Record scan with URL-encoded vendor code segment
given: A numeric badge identifier and a URL-encoded vendor code segment (e.g. `EXHIBITOR%20ONE` decoding to `EXHIBITOR ONE`)
The scan query returns exactly one matching record
scenarios.when: The client submits the scan request with the encoded code
then: The client receives the scan confirmation page displaying the decoded vendor code (e.g. `EXHIBITOR ONE`)

scenarios.title: Record scan via POST submission with vendor code and optional note
given: A numeric badge identifier, an explicit vendor code, and a note in the submission body (e.g. `Follow up regarding quote`)
The scan query returns exactly one matching record
scenarios.when: The client submits a POST scan request to the endpoint
then: The client receives the scan confirmation page displaying the vendor code
